intent.raw: Start a fresh Craft context, use Invoke define, design, and plan to author the whole agent reasoning engine with semantic-judgment evaluator@1 as its first executable witness, and define, design, plan, dry-run, and execute a quick intent-schema experiment so the schema is selected from populated data instead of guessed. Finish with one bounded Craft refresh subagent.
intent.objective: Produce an evidence-informed, implementation-ready private authoring package for an agent reasoning engine while preserving CAV2 intent, authority, schema, claim-proof, challenge, entry-gate, and exact-effect boundaries; stop before evaluator implementation.
intent.operator_sentence: Use real intent records to decide the schema, then design and plan the whole reasoning engine around a finite semantic evaluator witness before any implementation action.
intent.purpose: Give agents a governed, traceable way to preserve intent, select risk-sensitive reasoning methods, derive typed semantic judgments, abstain when support is insufficient, and withhold effects until a separate exact-action gate passes.

included: fresh scoped Craft workspace and linked human view
whole-engine define, design, and plan artifacts
intent-schema data experiment and evidence mechanics
one bounded live population experiment over repository-local intent records
one final capability-bound Craft refresh subagent
excluded: canonical CAV2 definition or constitution mutation
reasoning-engine or anti-bias efficacy promotion claims
protected_effects: closing owner decisions without an approval record

constraints.statement: CAV2-D39 Intent remains the semantic source; the experiment may instantiate or challenge a candidate record shape but may not redefine Intent.
Schema conformance is shape evidence only and never establishes truth, ownership, approval, or promotion.
Entry block or defer produces zero actor and evaluator calls; no effect occurs without both a positive semantic outcome and an exact-effect Gate pass.
The intent corpus remains private and repository-local; source text or handles are not copied into public Arcanum or the orchestrator repository.
The final Craft refresh subagent may update only the scoped Craft ledger, derived index, human view, and Craft artifacts, and may not reinterpret native receipts.

target_pressure: The repository can govern and coordinate agent work but does not yet own executable problem-level semantic reduction before action.
Agents may silently replace source intent with inferred scope, solution fixation, implementation convenience, or unsupported defaults.
A schema selected only from intuition would encode the same framing bias the reasoning engine is intended to expose.
Effort, consensus, receipts, and challenge machinery can be mistaken for evidence or authority unless their boundaries are machine-visible.

current_output_hypothesis.kind: private invoke authoring package plus empirical intent-schema evidence
current_output_hypothesis.description: A fresh Craft workspace coordinates two linked tracks: a bounded intent-schema population experiment and a whole-engine Invoke define/design/plan chain whose first planned implementation witness is semantic-judgment evaluator@1.

allowed_changes: replace candidate fields after experiment evidence

technique_overlays.trigger: The proposed intent fields are plausible but have not been populated and challenged against a varied real corpus.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every populated field preserves source provenance and declared-versus-inferred posture; missing data remains unresolved, passing and failing fixtures validate mechanically, and holdout results drive a recorded schema-selection decision.

technique_overlays.trigger: Private CAV2 definitions and research evidence inform a candidate implementation plan without authorizing canonical or public mutation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: All writes remain under the private development target and scoped Craft workspace; canonical definitions, public Arcanum, and the orchestrator evidence repository remain unchanged.

technique_overlays.trigger: The whole-engine plan must begin with the narrowest reversible trust-building witness rather than a general reasoning-engine implementation bundle.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Invoke plan and its mandatory Distill pass isolate semantic-judgment evaluator@1 as the first executable SWU, prove how it recomposes into the whole engine, and stop before implementation.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The operator explicitly corrected the execution route to run dependency-independent authoring tasks in parallel and retained one final Craft refresh subagent.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Two non-overlapping Invoke authoring lanes run concurrently after Craft start; their outputs join before evidence mechanics. A separate terminal Craft keeper later synchronizes passed receipts without receiving Invoke authority.
context: The fresh scoped Craft workspace avoids the parent cyberAlchemy-v2 ledger's active legacy schema-drift blocker.
The refresh must preserve native receipts rather than rewrite their conclusions.
The engine-definition and experiment-authoring lanes have disjoint write scopes and share only frozen source inputs.
Experiment design and plan remain sequential inside their lane, and all authoring outputs join before evidence mechanics.
The Craft refresh subagent runs only after the engine plan and experiment evidence have joined.

roles.purpose: Author the whole-engine define baseline and candidate intent-record contract while preserving the unwitnessed posture.
roles.owns: Invoke define artifacts and the s1 native-stage receipt only

roles.purpose: Define the pre-registered intent-schema population experiment in parallel with the whole-engine define baseline.
roles.owns: Invoke experiment define artifacts and the s2 native-stage receipt only

roles.purpose: Build and dry-run the project-local schemas, validator, and synthetic fixtures required before the live intent population run.
roles.owns: Research Evidence Harness mechanics and the s5 native-stage receipt only

roles.purpose: Execute exactly SWU-INTENT-001 over one frozen 12+3 repository-local corpus using the unchanged s5 mechanics.
roles.owns: One live run directory and the s6 Task Session receipt only
input_refs: twelve source-locked population records plus three held-out records drawn from repository-local dispatch, Craft, Invoke/work-pack, and current-intent sources

roles.purpose: Synchronize the completed authoring and experiment receipts into the scoped Craft source ledger, rebuild its index, update the linked human view, validate the workspace, and record residue plus the next executable SWU.
roles.owns: Craft refresh receipt and scoped Craft state only

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run dependency-independent authoring lanes concurrently, join and validate them before evidence mechanics, then run the final Craft keeper only after every required receipt passes?

steps.name: Start the scoped agent reasoning-engine Craft workspace

capability_metadata.validation_note: The active Dispatch Spec validator capability registry does not yet enumerate the installed canonical Craft sigil.

stop_conditions: block if an existing Craft workspace already owns this exact scoped target
block if the new ledger cannot validate against the current Craft schema
block if starting this workspace mutates the parent cyberAlchemy-v2 Craft ledger

steps.name: Define the whole reasoning-engine boundary and first witness
stop_conditions: block if the definition labels the current repository or candidate package a functioning reasoning engine
block if semantic-judgment evaluator@1 is not isolated as the first executable witness
block if IntentRecord, ProblemFrame, GateDecision, ReasoningReceipt, effort, evidence, or authority collapse into one object

steps.name: Define the intent-schema population experiment
stop_conditions: block if the experiment can upgrade a definition or reasoning-engine claim
block if source intent and normalized field values are not separately represented
block if missing data may be populated by hidden defaults

steps.name: Design the real-data intent-schema experiment

inputs.ref: repository-local stratified corpus: dispatch intents, Craft purpose/next-move records, Invoke/work-pack objectives, and held-out intents

stop_conditions: block unless the corpus selection is source-locked, stratified, private, and reproducible
block unless each field can record declared, inferred, or unresolved posture with source references
block unless the design distinguishes descriptive metrics from admission criteria

steps.name: Plan one bounded intent-schema evidence SWU
stop_conditions: block unless mandatory Invoke plan Distill validation passes
block unless the work-pack selects exactly one first live-data SWU
block if the SWU combines schema mechanics, live population, admission decision, and engine implementation

steps.name: Build and validate intent-schema evidence mechanics

capability_metadata.validation_note: The active Dispatch Spec validator capability registry does not yet enumerate the installed canonical Research Evidence Harness sigil.

stop_conditions: block unless at least one passing and one failing synthetic fixture behave as expected
block if dry-run fixtures are reported as live empirical support
block if malformed provenance, missing run metadata, or hidden field defaults are accepted

steps.name: Run one real-data intent-schema population SWU

inputs.ref: twelve source-locked population records plus three held-out records drawn from repository-local dispatch, Craft, Invoke/work-pack, and current-intent sources

stop_conditions: block if any corpus source cannot be pinned to a concrete path, selector, digest, or durable current-intent record
block if inferred values are reported as declared or unresolved values are guessed
block if the holdout set is used to redesign the candidate before evaluation
stop after one selected SWU and its receipt

steps.name: Reconcile the engine definition with observed intent-schema data
stop_conditions: block without a recorded human schema-selection approval after the live result
block if descriptive corpus frequency is treated as semantic necessity
block if candidate fields are promoted into CAV2-D39 or CAV2-D56

steps.name: Design the complete pre-action reasoning engine
stop_conditions: block unless all six Invoke design views are complete
block if entry Gate, actor protocol, semantic evaluator, reasoning receipt, exact-effect Gate, and effect attempt are substitutable or reordered
block if effort, subagent count, consensus, schema conformance, or AntiBiasVector supplies truth or authority

steps.name: Plan the whole engine and isolate semantic-judgment evaluator@1 as the first witness
stop_conditions: block unless mandatory Invoke plan Distill validation passes

block unless the first SWU is only semantic-judgment evaluator@1 with a finite owner-authorized catalog, typed outcomes, two independent rule families, counterfactual fixtures, deterministic replay, persisted gate ordering, and an exact-effect test double
block if the first SWU also implements the full actor runtime, generalized AntiBiasVector, external effects, or public packaging
stop before Task Session, goal, or any mutation-capable implementation handoff

steps.name: Refresh scoped Craft state from accepted native receipts

capability_metadata.validation_note: The active Dispatch Spec validator capability registry does not yet enumerate the installed canonical Craft sigil.

stop_conditions: block unless every consumed receipt exists, matches this dispatch, and has a terminal status
block if the subagent attempts to change native Invoke, experiment, or Task Session artifacts
block if a blocker is closed without evidence or a candidate schema or definition is promoted
block unless ledger validation and the derived index and human view synchronization pass

gates.condition: The operator confirmed the fresh scoped workspace and final Craft keeper, then explicitly corrected the route on 2026-07-22 so dependency-independent authoring tasks execute in parallel.
The fresh scoped ledger, indexes, human view, initial definitions, residue, and next move validate without mutating or claiming conformance for the parent legacy ledger.
The baseline spec preserves the accepted unwitnessed-candidate posture, whole-engine boundary, CAV2 vocabulary references, and finite first-witness claim.
The engine baseline and experiment definition workers both return passing native-stage receipts from disjoint write scopes before experiment design begins.
The experiment define and six-view design are approved; its work-pack isolates one live-data SWU and mandatory Distill validation passes.
Run schemas, JSONL validator, metrics, and at least one passing and one failing synthetic fixture validate while preserving the dry-run/live evidence split.
One selected SWU returns a source-locked, schema-valid corpus manifest, populated records, held-out results, metrics, residue, and a terminal execution receipt without schema or claim promotion.

After reviewing the live result, the owner records which candidate fields are retained, revised, split, or rejected and which unresolved observations remain residue. Corpus frequency alone cannot decide semantic necessity.

All six design views preserve intent provenance, authority applicability, entry/effect gate separation, actor protocol replay, evaluator semantics, effort control, challenge closure, receipt boundaries, and failure behavior.

The medium/high work-pack contains L0-L3 layering, implementation details, task-local SWUs, validation surfaces, a recomposition proof, and a passing Distill verdict; semantic-judgment evaluator@1 is the narrowest first SWU.

gates.owner: CAV2 definitions, constitution, decision, and public-private owners
gates.condition: No research, schema, experiment, Invoke, Craft, dispatch, or planning receipt promotes a definition, constitution, authority kind, runtime contract, implementation status, anti-bias efficacy claim, public artifact, or reasoning-engine claim.

The one Craft refresh keeper returns its declared receipt, joins, closes, stays inside the Craft-only write scope, preserves receipt meaning, validates the scoped ledger, and synchronizes the machine index and human view.

boundaries.from_owner: CAV2 authority and cyberalchemy-orchestrator research owners
boundaries.contract: Definitions, constitutions, and accepted research are read by path and selector. They are not copied as new authority, edited, or used to imply implementation status.

Synthetic fixtures prove mechanics only. Live source-locked population and held-out results are recorded separately, and only a human selection gate may admit candidate schema fields into the private spec.
Invoke owns authoring only. The dispatch stops after a validated plan and does not authorize or execute the semantic evaluator witness.
The subagent may write only the four declared Craft surfaces, may consume only joined terminal receipts, and may record but not reinterpret, approve, promote, or execute their content.
No step writes private material into arcanum/, projects/cyberalchemy-orchestrator/, or another public/external surface. Any future derivative requires a separate boundary scrub and owner gate.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns define/design/plan authoring; Craft owns scoped ledger state; future Task Session owns implementation execution.
authority.execution: Parent orchestrator owns sequential stages; Task Session owns only the selected intent-schema population SWU; the Craft keeper owns only final ledger synchronization.
authority.validation: Dispatch Spec validates route shape; Research Evidence Harness validates dry-run mechanics; Invoke and Distill validate authored phases; Task Session validates the selected live SWU; Craft validates ledger state.
authority.evidence: Source owners retain source meaning; Research Evidence Harness and Task Session own experiment receipts; Invoke owns authoring receipts.
authority.memory: Craft retains route memory and residue without becoming semantic or promotion authority.
authority.promotion: CAV2 definitions-governance, constitution-governance, decision gates, artifact-admission owners, and public-private owners only.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Write only private spec, experiment authoring, design, planning, and receipt artifacts under cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/.
Write only dry-run mechanics, source-locked run bundles, metrics, results, and task receipts under experiments/intent-schema/evidence, experiments/intent-schema/runs, and receipts.
Craft alone owns .craft/ledger.yml, .craft/index.json, .craft/artifacts/, and CRAFT.md; the final subagent is limited to these declared paths.

state_namespaces.owner: definitions-governance, constitution-governance, and other named authority owners
state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only for this dispatch; no canonical authority mutation.

promotion_splits.source: intent-schema experiment fixtures and live run
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may inform a recorded candidate-field decision only after g6; it cannot redefine CAV2-D39, promote a schema, or prove reasoning efficacy.
Authoring artifacts stop at implementation readiness; a later selected Task Session or goal and its exact receipts are required for implementation evidence.
No direct movement. A separate public-safe derivative, boundary scrub, and owner approval are required.

promotion_guardrails: CAV2-D39 Intent and CAV2-D56 Schema are referenced, not redefined.
A populated intent record is a candidate instance, not proof that its interpretation is correct.
Schema validity is shape evidence and never authority, truth, approval, or semantic sufficiency.
Synthetic fixtures validate evidence mechanics only; live population data remains bounded empirical evidence.
Corpus frequency does not establish semantic necessity; the owner gate records candidate-field admission and residue.
Effort tier, agent count, consensus, challenge count, and receipt volume do not increase truth or authority.
AntiBiasVector remains excluded from the first evaluator witness until dimensions, interventions, observations, and validation semantics are separately governed and witnessed.
Invoke artifacts do not constitute implementation or runtime evidence.
Semantic-judgment evaluator@1 remains an unwitnessed candidate until a later execution route returns the required fixture and effect-boundary evidence.
The final Craft refresh records state and residue; it cannot reinterpret receipts, close unsupported blockers, or promote candidates.
No task writes private content into arcanum/ or projects/cyberalchemy-orchestrator/.
